units.key: § Emuqu — A Measurement-Grounded Assistant with a Multilingual Regulated-Claim Per > Executive Summary
units.does: Summarizes: coach on six providers; typed fact catalog with one JSON envelope and nine-value absence taxonomy; 21 read tools + 19 allow-listed actions, destructive or unstated writes run only after the user's explicit yes; runtime number verification with corrections carried into the next prompt until a reply to it is checked; removal of the stale dashboard block on user contradiction; 29-concept/17-language lexicon driving the input guard, an output guard that passes the app's canned safety replies unchanged, the build-time linter and a CI coverage gate.

units.key: § Emuqu — A Measurement-Grounded Assistant with a Multilingual Regulated-Claim Per > 3. Methods > 3.2 Compact tool layer
units.does: Specifies the compact tool layer: 40 tools from 239 entries, 21 fixed read tools plus 19 allow-listed actions of 20 declared (location.roads_ahead not allow-listed), the allow-list also gating dispatch (unknown or per-entry names -> invalidParameter); read tools first, dedupe by name first-wins, sorted; capability index of first sentence capped at 170 chars; BM25 (k1 1.5, b 0.75) filtering only above 40; per-turn budget of 8 calls with the crossing round's calls that fit resolved and those past it rateLimited, then one text round; same constant on device. Confirmation: memory remove/clear and contact remove run only when the model repeats the call and the user's next message is an explicit yes (<=5 words, an affirmation opening, no negation), lapsing on another reply, a later turn or 10 minutes, one pending at a time; memory add, contact add, route rename and set address take the same step when a value is not in the user's latest message; email draft and contact save/remove need user_quote from the latest message, draft shown in the system mail composer. units.key: § Emuqu — A Measurement-Grounded Assistant with a Multilingual Regulated-Claim Per > 3. Methods > 3.3 Runtime number verification > 3.3.1 Claim shapes and tolerances
units.does: Specifies two verified families: live workout (HR, power, alpha1; HR drift in voice) against the broker's snapshot in chat (nothing while no workout records) and the recorder's in voice, at chat round end before the app-state pass and per voice chunk; app state (TSB/ATL/CTL/ACWR from the training-load registry, skipped while training load is paused; RMSSD and recovery from today's reliable overnight; sleep duration/efficiency from the night get_sleep latest answers about, only with frozen sleep). Claim shapes: HR/power with optional unit after the 'your X is'/'X right now' shape and no %/dash/slash/decimal/time unit after; TSB/ATL/CTL/ACWR/RMSSD/recovery [score] with an optional connector run (is, of, at, now, currently, today, sitting, sits, reads, stands at, right now, ':' or '='); tolerances HR 5, power 15, alpha1 0.10, drift 1.5, TSB 2.0, ATL/CTL 3.0, ACWR 0.15, RMSSD 8, recovery 4.0 (0-100, corrected to the dashboard integer) / 1.0 (0-10), sleep 5/30 min, efficiency 1.0; time/count units exclude a match. Code: MetricsVerifier heartRateDiscrepancies/powerDiscrepancies/alpha1Discrepancies/hrDriftDiscrepancies/verifyLive/trainingLoadDiscrepancies/acwrDiscrepancies/overnightDiscrepancies/rmssdClaims/recoveryScoreClaims/onTheClaimsScale/lastNightSleepDiscrepancies/sleepDurationDiscrepancies/sleepEfficiencyDiscrepancies; AssistantViewModel+Tools.verifyAppStateNumbers.

units.key: § Emuqu — A Measurement-Grounded Assistant with a Multilingual Regulated-Claim Per > 3. Methods > 3.3 Runtime number verification > 3.3.2 Algorithm (app-state family)
units.does: Specifies the app-state algorithm: normalize English spelled numbers 0-999 (hundreds, the 'one-sixty' form, tens+ones, ones/teens, optional 'negative', 'point' + any number of digit words) recording rewrites; run metric regexes; read each match's sentence from its start to the end of the claim's clause (first separator , ; ( — – spaced hyphen vs versus compared but while whereas from) and drop it on a time or target/comparison marker; negate 'negative'; compare with tolerance; recovery dual scale; sleep only when the text mentions sleep, with norm/other-night filters; remap offsets snapping to rewrites; replace spans back-to-front skipping overlaps. The live family runs normalization, matching, markers, tolerance and remap too, with the 'your X is'/'X right now' shape and an optional unit. Code: MetricsVerifier.verifyAppStateClaims/verifyLive/correctedText/claimsMatching/discrepancy/isAboutTheCurrentValue/clauseEnd/sentenceRange/isInSleepSentence/isNotAboutLastNight/normalizeSpelledNumbers/remap and SpelledNumberNormalizer.normalizeWithRewrites/originalOffset/spelledNumberPattern/spelledNumberReplacement/spelledInteger.

units.key: § Emuqu — A Measurement-Grounded Assistant with a Multilingual Regulated-Claim Per > 3. Methods > 3.3 Runtime number verification > 3.3.3 Where verification runs
units.does: Specifies where verification runs: chat at the end of every tool-loop round, live-workout then app-state, after the text that preceded a tool call has been cleared, on the text that stays, corrected text replacing the saved turn; voice chunk path output scrub -> live-workout verification -> app-state verification -> preamble -> speech normalization. Code: AssistantViewModel+Tools.applyRoundEndTextPolicy (rewind, then verifyAppStateNumbers), VoiceConversationController+Speech.applyHallucinationGuard/liveWorkoutCorrected/appStateCorrected/perimeterScrubbed/speak.

units.key: § Emuqu — A Measurement-Grounded Assistant with a Multilingual Regulated-Claim Per > 3. Methods > 3.3 Runtime number verification > 3.3.4 Correction loop
units.does: Specifies the correction loop: discrepancies into a process-wide lock-guarded buffer deduplicated by (metric, claimed, actual), capped at 4; every prompt composed afterwards carries them in a '# Last turn correction — DO NOT FABRICATE' variable section outside the cached prefix naming the tools to call; composing moves them to a delivered list (at most 4 shown) without retiring them, the next reply's app-state verification retires the delivered ones, clearing the conversation empties the buffer, nothing survives a relaunch. Code: MetricsVerifier.recordCorrections/pendingCorrectionsBlock/acknowledgeDeliveredCorrections/clearCorrections/correctionsBlock, AssistantSystemPrompt.variableSections, AssistantViewModel.clearConversation.

units.key: § Emuqu — A Measurement-Grounded Assistant with a Multilingual Regulated-Claim Per > 3. Methods > 3.5 The multilingual regulated-claim lexicon
units.does: Specifies the lexicon: concepts with word-bounded latin and substring unbounded alternatives compiled case-insensitively on the original text; 17 languages with a test requiring CJK/Korean/Arabic alternatives; 29 concepts plus a 2-concept offensive list; per-alternative benign-homonym exclusions; groups refuseBeforeSending 12, scrubFromOutput 21, neverInStaticCopy 12 with eight input-only concepts. neverInStaticCopy leaves out concepts the app's own copy uses (its safety replies say 'talk to your doctor', a medicalReferral match; its Diagnostics feature is a diagnosis form); the 12 kept appear in no locale outside the allow-listed disclaimers (the linter runs clean). Code: MedicalTermLexicon.swift (groups refuseAsRhythm/refuseAsEmergency/refuseAsSymptom/refuseBeforeSending/scrubFromOutput/neverInStaticCopy), MedicalTermLexicon+Injury.swift, MedicalTermLexicon+MetricVerdict.swift; lint.py translated_claim_patterns loads all 12.

units.key: § Emuqu — A Measurement-Grounded Assistant with a Multilingual Regulated-Claim Per > 3. Methods > 3.6 Input guard
units.does: Specifies the input guard: prompt rules A-D; classification of the trimmed message with typographic apostrophes folded, in the order self-harm, emergency, injury, rhythm, danger judgement; fixed localized crisis/symptom/injury/rhythm replies; on refusal both turns stored localOnly and nothing sent, before the provider and consent checks; self-harm answered even with medicalGuardEnabled off; prompt parity tests; the output guard passes these replies unchanged as a reply; voice echo trap at >=40% token overlap with the last refusal. Code: MedicalQueryGuard.classify/evaluate/cannedReplies/selfHarmReply/symptomReplyTemplate/injuryReply/arrhythmiaReply, AssistantViewModel.send/medicalGuardRefused/appendExchange, VoiceAudioPipeline.isMedicalRefusalEcho (>= 0.4).

units.key: § Emuqu — A Measurement-Grounded Assistant with a Multilingual Regulated-Claim Per > 3. Methods > 3.7 Output guard
units.does: Specifies the output guard: negation-neutral sentence deflections (13 medical + 1 offensive); the app's four canned safety replies (in-app language and English) passed byte-identical when a sentence is a reply's opening sentence or the next sentence of a reply under way, compared after emphasis removal, apostrophe folding, whitespace collapse and case folding, with progress carried between pieces of one reply and a model's own sentence before them breaking the match; English-only offensive entries gated by recognizer confidence 0.6 on >=3 words; scrub pseudocode with exact segmentation, markdown-stripped retry, straddle collapse or whole-message deflection, tidying of rewritten sentences only; decimal-aware terminators; streaming buffer publishing every 33 ms only complete sentences, a trailing run of soft terminators (line break, Arabic comma) held for the next sentence, progress reset on rewind; speech scrub of every utterance with the chunker's progress, reset per reply; final whole-message pass. Code: CoachVoiceGuard.scrub(_:)/scrub(_:continuing:)/continuesSafetyCopy/safetyCopyReplies/safetyCopyKey/scrubRun/deflectStraddlingMatch/replacing/firstMatchingEntry/firstMatch/withoutInlineEmphasis/tidy/rewrite/sentenceSegments/endOfSegment/isSentenceTerminator/splitAtLastSentenceBoundary/lastSafeCut/deflections, OffensiveTermLexicon.appliesToReply/confidentLanguage, StreamTextBuffer.append/flush/takePublishableText/scrubbing/rewindToRoundStart, SpokenTextChunker.reset, perimeterScrubbed(_:continuing:), AssistantTurnRouter.scrubForCoachVoice.

units.key: § Emuqu — A Measurement-Grounded Assistant with a Multilingual Regulated-Claim Per > 3. Methods > 3.9 Coverage gate
units.does: Specifies the coverage gate (scripts/check_perimeter_sync.sh): extract every latin/unbounded literal from the MedicalTermLexicon* files with bracket matching that skips literals, word-bound latin ones; exit 2 if an alternative does not compile, matches the empty string, or fewer than 100 were extracted (989 at 6b195c6); expand every spelling of each build-time pattern (each branch, optional part present and absent, each class member; * and {m,n} minimum, + once; \s space, \w a placeholder word, \d a digit; (?i), \b and lookarounds dropped); exit 2 if a pattern cannot be expanded, has none or more than 5,000 spellings, or a spelling misses its own pattern; exit 1 listing each spelling no alternative matches; 62 patterns -> 590 spellings, no gaps.

units.key: § Emuqu — A Measurement-Grounded Assistant with a Multilingual Regulated-Claim Per > 7. Design Tradeoffs
units.does: States design tradeoffs: a lexical perimeter; negation-neutral deflection; guards over prompt rules; the input guard reads the current message only; number verification covers present-value claims for the 11 metrics of Table 3.4 in English only; in chat the correction lands at round end; the 21 read tools are static; a destructive or unstated write costs one extra yes, a long or hedged reply cancels; the 8-call budget per turn; the coverage gate is one-directional; model-drafted emails and auto-extracted memories sit outside the output guard; canned safety replies pass only as whole replies from their opening sentence; fallback only with Apple Intelligence selected under the routing mode and never after a mutating tool. Code: AssistantViewModel+Tools (resolveToolCalls, resultJSON, verifyAppStateNumbers, ranMutatingTool, runRoundKeepingActionsOnThisModel), TurnRouter.failureFallback, AffirmationReply.isExplicitYes, CoachVoiceGuard.continuesSafetyCopy, AssistantTurnRouter.extractFactsInBackground.
